cost_review.existing_cache: Guest wheel/shader caches were ephemeral and removed with the VM. No authorized persistent cache remains.
cost_review.prebuilt_image: Could reuse installed packages/shaders, but requires image creation, retention/storage cost and secret/identity sanitization. No image created. Not justified for one diagnostic yet.
cost_review.local_cache: Windows package cache cannot supply the distinct Linux Python/CUDA/Kit environment without an explicitly prepared transferable wheelhouse. No large package downloads performed locally.
cost_review.selected: Cold setup with exact observed version constraints, explicit install timestamps and same 25 minute VM deadline. Pins reduce resolver drift, not download volume; no claimed measured speedup.
cost_review.remaining: Actual billing and NAT byte totals unavailable. Do not infer leftover allowance from guest duration.
